title: CAD incident records for 20 specified case numbers
summary: Requests, for each of 20 specified CAD incident numbers spanning March 2025 through March 2026: (1) the incident or case report, including any assigned RMS case or report number; (2) the CAD event chronology, unit history, or dispatch log for the call, as distinct from the narrative report; and (3) where any record is withheld, an index entry identifying it and the specific exemption asserted, including whether the underlying matter is active or closed if § 7923.600 is invoked.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department applies the exemption on an individualized, per-record basis rather than categorically across all 20 incidents.

filed_because: Tests whether the Department can produce the underlying incident report and CAD dispatch chronology for a defined set of closed calls, and whether § 7923.600 is invoked per-record or as a blanket denial.
notes: Filed 2026-09-14. Statutory 10-calendar-day determination due 2026-09-24 (Gov. Code § 7922.535(a)). Awaiting initial agency response.
